cases.name: analyze-process-recording
cases.prompt: Analyze this operations walkthrough and map the trigger, systems, documents, human decisions, failure modes, and automation opportunities with timestamps.
expectedBehaviors: Distinguishes observed, stated, and inferred claims
Cites timestamps or identifies unavailable evidence

cases.name: reconcile-old-walkthrough
cases.prompt: This video predates our latest workflow changes. Extract what it shows and compare it with the current procedure document.
expectedBehaviors: Preserves the walkthrough as dated evidence
Does not assume either source is authoritative without support

cases.name: summary-only-boundary
cases.prompt: I only have Gemini's summary of the recording. Document the process and be explicit about what you could not directly verify.
expectedBehaviors: Identifies the summary as secondary evidence
Does not claim to have watched the recording
Marks unshown details and targeted verification questions

cases.name: transcribe-only
cases.prompt: Transcribe this audio word for word and do not analyze the workflow.

cases.name: architecture-from-requirements
cases.prompt: Design the implementation architecture from this already-approved technical specification.
expectedBehaviors: Routes to architecture or implementation planning
